mostWorthwhile.text: Building the reef partnership and then its mineral skeleton made the relationship between living organisms and reef architecture clear.

leastWorthwhile.text: Trying to add swimmers directly to the coral reef went nowhere; it was unclear then that the reef would be used later alongside another habitat.

surprise.text: The crowded coast emerged by joining nursery waters with a reef and then adding tides, rather than simply populating the reef with animals.

arbitrary.text: The final use of tides was understandable once explained, but its role in completing the coastal mosaic was not obvious before inspection.
